```artifact
Feature: Alarm System - U05_Alarms

  Scenario: Alarm occurrences are logged - [RW-SW-27]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When an alarm is triggered
    Then the event log contains an entry for the alarm occurrence

  Scenario: Alarm inhibitions are logged - [RW-SW-28]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When an alarm is inhibited
    Then the event log contains an entry for the alarm inhibition

  Scenario: Alarm cancellations are logged - [RW-SW-28]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When an alarm is cancelled
    Then the event log contains an entry for the alarm cancellation

  Scenario: Alarm resets are logged - [RW-SW-28]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When an alarm is reset
    Then the event log contains an entry for the alarm reset

  Scenario: Alarm acknowledgements are logged - [RW-SW-28]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When an alarm is acknowledged
    Then the event log contains an entry for the alarm acknowledgement

  Scenario Outline: Inhibit alarms via GUI - [RW-SW-31]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When the user inhibits alarm "<alarm_name>" via the GUI
    Then the alarm "<alarm_name>" is inhibited
    Examples:
      | alarm_name |
      | High PIP   |
      | Low TV     |
      | Leakage     |

  Scenario Outline: Acknowledge alarms via GUI - [RW-SW-32]
    Given the alarm system is running and alarm "<alarm_name>" is active
    When the user acknowledges alarm "<alarm_name>" via the GUI
    Then the alarm "<alarm_name>" is acknowledged
    Examples:
      | alarm_name |
      | High PIP   |
      | Low TV     |
      | Leakage     |

  Scenario Outline: Cancel alarms via GUI - [RW-SW-33]
    Given the alarm system is running and alarm "<alarm_name>" is active
    When the user cancels alarm "<alarm_name>" via the GUI
    Then the alarm "<alarm_name>" is cancelled
    Examples:
      | alarm_name |
      | High PIP   |
      | Low TV     |
      | Leakage     |

  Scenario Outline: Set Inspiration Tidal Volume Alarm Threshold - [RW-SW-39]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When the user sets the inspiration tidal volume alarm threshold to "<tidal_volume>" ml via the GUI
    Then the inspiration tidal volume alarm threshold is set to "<tidal_volume>" ml
    Examples:
      | tidal_volume |
      | 80          |
      | 3000        |
      | 1500        |
      | 10          |
      | 2990        |
      | 3010        |

  Scenario Outline: PIP Alarm Fires After Consecutive Breaths - [RW-SW-42]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When the PIP exceeds "<pip_threshold>" ml for 3 consecutive breaths
    Then a PIP alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | pip_threshold |
      | 20           |
      | 35           |
      | 10           |
      | 50           |

  Scenario Outline: Leakage Alarm Fires - [RW-SW-44]
    Given the alarm system is running
    When the leakage exceeds "<leakage_threshold>" lpm
    Then a leakage alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | leakage_threshold |
      | 5              |
      | 150            |
      | 75             |
      | 10             |
      | 145            |
      | 0              |
      | 151            |
```
